canonical_topic: NGL trading hubs and physical vs. financial trading
definition: Most NGL trading occurs at hub locations with dense pipeline and refinery connectivity, chiefly Mont Belvieu, Texas (near Houston) and Conway, Kansas.
core_idea: NGLs trade both physically (seller-to-buyer product transfer) and financially (derivatives cash-settled against an index price).
key_points: Mont Belvieu, TX and Conway, KS are the two largest NGL trading hubs.
Trading occurs both physically and via financial/derivative index-settled contracts.
trading_implications: Hub concentration around pipeline/refinery-dense regions (especially the Gulf Coast) is central to how NGL price discovery and liquidity form.
